title: A field with no object named
transcript:
Consultant: Anything else outstanding?
Client: We need somewhere to record the contract end date. It keeps getting
lost between the sales team and finance.
Consultant: Which record should it live on?
Client: That is a good question. It might belong on the account, or on the
opportunity, or on the new renewal thing we discussed. I genuinely do not know.
Consultant: We will need to decide that before building it.
Client: Agreed. Write it down, but do not pick for me.

expected.note: The field is real; the object is explicitly undecided and must not be guessed.

notes: The client says outright not to choose. Picking an object here is the invention the confidence rule exists to catch.
